facts.fact: ITWeb reports the Information Regulator, set up in December 2016, has the job among others of monitoring and enforcing compliance with the Promotion of Access to Information Act.

ZAF.note: Document states no AI harm rule, authority or enforcement; it argues about who should regulate AI.
No government use of AI stated.
Only the withdrawn draft National AI Policy is named, a policy and not a law or draft rule.

facts.fact: ITWeb, citing Prof Sizwe Snail ka Mtuze, says South Africa's draft National AI Policy was withdrawn earlier in 2026 and an AI policy is still to come.

ZAF.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: ITWeb reports the Information Regulator, headed by advocate Pansy Tlakula, was set up with its first members in December 2016 to enforce POPIA.

ITWeb reports the Information Regulator has issued enforcement notices, with First National Bank and a TVET college among the most recent found in breach of POPIA, and earlier notices against the Department of Justice and Correctional Services.
ITWeb reports the Protection of Personal Information Act came into force on 1 July 2021 after a year-long grace period.
